title: Your brain runs on 20 watts 🧠 #shorts
description:
Your brain has about 86 billion neurons. It's roughly 2% of body weight but uses about 20% of your energy at rest — around 20 watts, less than a light bulb.
Sources: Azevedo et al. 2009, J Comp Neurol (86 billion neurons); Raichle & Gusnard 2002, PNAS (brain ~2% of body mass, ~20% of energy).

Inner Numbers — your body, counted. New Short every day.
Educational content, not medical advice.

scenes.say: Your brain has about eighty six billion neurons.
It's only about two percent of your body weight.
But it uses about twenty percent of your energy.
All of that runs on about twenty watts. Less than a light bulb.
And it's reading this right now. Follow for more of your body, counted.
